name: Wil
source:
“You are the one I must protect… and someone I… truly value… as a friend.”

The youngest captain in the history of the Meisa Knights.
Renowned for his skill with the sword, he commands not only respect but genuine affection from his subordinates.
Deeply indebted to Gizeld for his position, Will has pledged unwavering loyalty to the prince.

Translated from [url=https://mu-game.net/got/character/]the official website[/url].]
